description: This Java class 'ProxyChangeListener' listens for system proxy configuration changes on Android devices, interacts with native code via JNI, and manages broadcast receivers for proxy change events. It includes reflection-based extraction of proxy info and handles different Android API levels.

classes.name: ProxyChangeListener
classes.description: Main class that listens for Android proxy change events, manages broadcast receivers, and communicates with native code.

classes.name: ProxyConfig
classes.description: Encapsulates proxy configuration details such as host, port, PAC URL, and exclusion list.

classes.name: ProxyReceiver
classes.description: Inner class extending BroadcastReceiver to handle proxy change broadcasts.

classes.name: Delegate
classes.description: Interface for testing, to notify when proxy settings change.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ProxyChangeListener.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a system property by name.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the listener with a native pointer and registers broadcast receivers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops listening and unregisters broadcast receivers.

methods.name: proxySettingsChanged
methods.description: Handles proxy configuration changes and notifies native code.

methods.name: extractNewProxy
methods.description: Uses reflection to extract proxy info from intent extras.

methods.name: getProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current proxy configuration, with special handling for Android Q+.

methods.name: updateProxyConfigFromConnectivityManager
methods.description: Updates proxy config based on connectivity manager info.

methods.name: registerBroadcastReceiver
methods.description: Registers broadcast receivers for proxy change events, handling different Android versions.

methods.name: assertOnThread
methods.description: Ensures methods are called on the correct thread.

methods.name: runOnThread
methods.description: Executes a runnable on the listener's thread.
